label: preparing
what: A surprise jubilee for the mayor in the great hall at day 1, 18:00, with 200 fresh loaves replacing spoiled bread and eight lanterns. Builder, freight and innkeeper coordinated funding, baking, delivery and the mayor's attendance under a lighting-inspection pretext; baker knowingly supplied 44 loaves on credit. Secretary scheduled the inspection but is not clearly a knowing helper and later told the mayor limited information about private bread arrangements and a jubilee; the full surprise purpose was not disclosed in the record. No evidence neighbour knowingly helped.
